description: Replace direct references in Out Loans disbursement formulas with existing named functions and ranges.
status: Applied and verified in the original financial plan.
scope: Only Out Loans J5 and J19 formula anchors changed; both retain their 96-month spills. No Apps Script source changes.
rationale: Use OUT_LOAN_COL_VALUE to identify the current loan, LOOKUP_BY_NAME to retrieve its original Date and Amount inputs, MONTH_START for the disbursement month, and R_MONTHS for the timeline. Looking up the original input fields preserves blank values rather than inheriting a previous loan's helper values.

changes.after:
=LET(
  loan_name, OUT_LOAN_COL_VALUE("Name"),
  loan_date, LOOKUP_BY_NAME(S_OUT_LOANS, "Date", "Name", loan_name),
  loan_amount, LOOKUP_BY_NAME(S_OUT_LOANS, "Amount", "Name", loan_name),
  ARRAYFORMULA(
    IF(R_MONTHS = IF(loan_date = "", "", MONTH_START(loan_date)), loan_amount, 0)
  )
)
